# Red

Red applies a dark red colour scheme drawn from the built-in Red theme of VS Code. Editor syntax, sidebars and UI panels are rendered in deep red tones for a high-contrast look.

![Red screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hat-im/obsidian-red-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Red"
    author: "Abdur Rahman Hatim"
    repo:   "hat-im/obsidian-red-theme"
    slug:   "red"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/red"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/hat-im/obsidian-red-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hat-im/obsidian-red-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a dark red color scheme inspired by VS Code's built-in Red theme. Render editor syntax, sidebars, and UI panels in deep red tones for a cohesive, high-contrast look."
}
```
